title: 美术角补充用品
audio_introduction: Listen to the whole conversation. Write p or b in each blank.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Penny, we need supplies for the new art corner. There is paper on my list. The first letter of paper is already filled in as the example.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Let us buy the other things today, Ben. What comes after paper?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Brushes and pencils. Our old brushes are dry, and the pencils are very short.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I have boxes for the small supplies and boards for the wall.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I also need beads for a picture frame and paint for our big sign.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then I will add pins and buttons to my list. The last thing is posters. We can put them above the art table.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That is everything. Please bring your list when we go shopping.

instruction: 听一段完整对话，完成两个人各五行的清单。左列首行为已解示例，其余9处只填 p 或 b，不填完整单词。源遍数及读答时间未知；本机单遍、前后各20秒，可重播，属于审阅安排。
local_rate_notice: 本机对话按实测词速做保留音高的减速，约110英文词/分钟；不是原录音速度，也未完成儿童难度或自然听辨标定。
scope_notice: 香港KS1学段官方教学形式的原创参照；未绑定内地小学具体年级，不计入15档年级覆盖或当前内地非纸笔真题。两列、9响应、一个示例、p/b候选和整段对话保留；主题和措辞为原创。
